mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.name, b.author, b.price, b.stock, COUNT(br.id) AS borrowCount FROM books b LEFT JOIN borrow_records br ON b.id = br.book_id GROUP BY b.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bookmanager_db.books (name, author, price, stock) VALUES(#{name}, #{author}, #{price}, #{stock});
mapper.update: UPDATE books SET stock = stock - 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE books SET stock = stock + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
